database.stem: The prices charged by your Accounting Department do not match those ------- to me by your Sales Department at the time of purchase.
database.raw_text:
The prices charged by your Accounting Department do not match those -------
to me by your Sales Department at the time of purchase.
(A) repeated
(B) informed
(C) recorded
(D) quoted
database.explanation:
those指代的是prices，“购买时销售部给我的报价”的句意
最恰当，故选 (D) quoted。quote有“引用，摘引”的词义，但在托业中一
般表示“报价，开价，出价”。
